input.quote: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause by delivering the written notice specified in Section 29.4. Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination.
input.rationale: Section 9.4 gives Customer an unqualified convenience-termination right over the Agreement or any Order Form, and Section 29.4 fixes the notice period at thirty days before the effective termination date — matching the preferred position's 30 days' written notice. Customer owes only accrued Fees and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (reinforced by Section 10.2), so there is no early-termination fee or penalty undercutting the exit. Vendor has no convenience right anywhere in the document: its termination rights are limited to material breach (9.1) and insolvency (9.2), so the three-year term (8.1) cannot be exited by Vendor mid-term. This meets the preferred position; no redline required.
